title: Deployment lanes and quarterly commitment framework for isolated instances
creator: Aisha Banerjee
description:
Objective: Define a repeatable quarterly framework that maps customer cohorts to specific deployment lanes (Managed VPC, Dedicated Pools, On‑Prem Appliance), ties commitments to measurable success criteria, and produces a thin, actionable delivery plan for engineering and ops. This ticket consolidates roadmap sequencing, acceptance gates, and OKRs for the isolated-instance funnel so PMs, Eng, Design, and SREs can operate to a shared quarterly commitment.

Why this work: We have increasing incoming demand for isolated deployments but inconsistent expectations across sales, solutions, and engineering. That causes scope creep on projects, uneven test coverage for upgrades, and unclear SLAs for onboarding. A concise "deployment lanes + commitment" framework will reduce cross-team rework, speed customer ramp, and make quarterly prioritization explicit.

Scope:
- Define three canonical lanes (Managed VPC, Dedicated Pools, On‑Prem Appliance) with minimal feature parity requirements for ship/upgrade/backup/telemetry.
- Specify OKRs / success metrics at lane level (onboarding time, upgrade success rate, mean time to recovery, time-to-production).
- Produce a per-lane acceptance gate checklist used by Eng and SRE for release gating.
- Map existing customer cohorts to lanes and identify 12 high-priority customer migrations for the quarter.
- Produce a dependency matrix linking infra work, console UX, billing, and legal/compliance sign‑offs.
- Capture rollout patterns and fallback policies for each lane (canary, dark launch, circuit breaker).

Out of scope: building the on‑prem installer or new KMS integrations (those are separate delivery tickets). This ticket produces the framework and the prioritized quarter plan that hands off to delivery epics.
acceptance_criteria: Three lanes documented with minimum viability checklist for each lane (ship, upgrade, rollback, telemetry)
Lane-level OKRs and 3 measurable metrics with target values and instrumentation owners
Priority list of 12 customer migrations with cohort rationale and success criteria
Dependency matrix that enumerates infra, console, billing, legal, and SRE prerequisites with owners
Release gating checklist and rollback playbook links for Eng and Ops
Stakeholder sign-off recorded (Product, Eng, SRE, Sales Solutions, Security)
A short one‑page exec summary for GTM and Customer Success containing commitment language
